name: Sun Cleric: Justice deals off-hand damage when dual-wielding two-handers (#5769, #5775)
contract: Justice 520747 (Spell.dbc: AttributesEx3 SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_MAIN_HAND_WEAPON, EquippedItemSubClassMask 1378 = two-handed axe/mace/sword/polearm/staff only) has two direct SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL effects: index 0 triggers 525006 (main-hand strike) and index 1 triggers 572042 (off-hand strike). 572042 has AttributesEx3 SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON set (verified via coa-dbc-viewer), so Spell::CheckCast (Spell.cpp) requires Player::GetWeaponForAttack(OFF_ATTACK) to be non-null before it can fire, and Spell::EffectWeaponDmg (SpellEffects.cpp) uses m_attackType == OFF_ATTACK (set from that same attribute in Spell::Spell) to compute off-hand weapon damage. AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp's idIsJustice() whitelist includes 572042 for its fire-school coefficient bump on effect index 1, confirming the OH trigger is the intended effect-bearing spell. Justice's own weapon mask only admits two-handers, so its off-hand strike depends on the Valkyr's Grip (707072) dual-2H-wield mechanic (already covered by sun-cleric-valkyr-grip-dual-polearms.json): with Valkyr's Grip learned and two 2H weapons equipped, the off-hand weapon check passes and 572042 must land real damage alongside the main-hand strike 525006, not stay silent.
